page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. No local storage is bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPUs or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, this instance is designed for workloads requiring stable processing and a larger memory footprint relative to compute capacity. The lack of hyperthreading ensures that each vCPU maps to a dedicated physical core, eliminating resource contention at the thread level. This configuration is suitable for memory-sensitive applications, small databases, caching layers, and lightweight enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
